relevance_note: Case report of a girl with Blau syndrome and her father and brother, all carrying a NOD2 variant ("This result confirmed the diagnosis of BS in all family members."), plus a literature table of renal-involvement cases.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a Python script assembled the JSON and copied Table 2 cells (row prefixes used as spans), checked against the table. Individuals: the proband ('patient'), 'father of patient', 'brother of patient', and 12 previously published people from Table 2 (no label column, so 'Table 2 row k'). Table 2 row 10 (reference (38)) holds three people whose values are stacked in single cells separated by spaces (e.g. '45 years 24 years 18 years', 'Female Female Male'); under D-31 they were not assigned by position, so these three are labelled 'Table 2 row 10 person 1-3' (numbering only, not tied to stacked positions); only arthritis ('Yes Yes Yes', identical for all three) and the shared reference were recorded; sex, ages, rash, eye, renal are not reported. The Table 2 'Age' column was recorded as age at last evaluation (it may be age at report). Table 2 'No' cells were taken as explicit absence; '–' cells as not reported (no legend). 'Eye manifestation: No' was mapped to checklist uveitis excluded only; other ocular items left not reported. Renal involvement 'Yes' was recorded as a feature but not mapped to the checklist item 'granulomatous nephritis or renal failure' (broader term). The text says only 10 literature patients with renal involvement were documented, while Table 2 lists 12 people (row 10 has three, of whom two have renal involvement 'No'). The Table 2 'Affected parents' relatives were not given rows (no individual-level facts). Variant: NOD2 NM_001370466.1 c.920G>A p.Arg307Gln; the paper states it corresponds to c.1001G>A (p.R334Q) on NM_022162.3 (not recorded as a separate row). Father and brother carry it per the family exome statement; inheritance for proband and brother recorded as 'inherited paternal' from the statement that the father's exome revealed the same variant (mother not mentioned). Variant type 'missense' recorded only for the proband (sentence names 'Our patient's'). Pathogenicity 'pathogenic' is the authors' statement citing ClinVar. HBA1 c.326delC carrier status recorded for all three (other gene, attributed explicitly). Contradictions/notes: radiograph text says 'with erosions or deformity' while Table 1 says 'with erosions and deformity' (Table 1 used). Kidney function was normal at the first visit (January 2021) and later abnormal (creatinine 1.9, renal failure at 13 years); both rows emitted with timing in severity_or_detail, checklist set to observed for renal failure as a later event, not a contradiction. Father's 'contractures at PIPs' was not mapped to checklist camptodactyly (paper does not use that word for him). 'No skin or ocular symptoms' in father and brother: skin rash checklist excluded; uveitis left not reported. Vital status not stated for anyone. Normal laboratory results recorded as excluded abnormalities (D-27).
